summary: Validated the new Paxity self-heal guard and full backend health (preview). Self-heal overrides stale legacy hosts (api.paxity.io / api.paxity.com) to https://transaction.paxity.io/api/v1 at import time; live host is kept as-is with no warning; default (unset) uses live host. Diagnostic returns 200 with SHOPPING EN CHINE balance. Config returns configured=true, 7 methods, XOF. All 3 validation paths return correct 400 French errors. 18/18 regression pytest pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Self-heal guard in paxity_router.py (lines 58-70) is correct and idempotent — safe to keep permanently as a safety net.
paxity_router.py is 666 lines — consider splitting models/service/routes for maintainability (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: None. No real transactions initiated (all payin calls hit 400 validation short-circuit).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Self-heal guard verified across 4 scenarios: (a) PAXITY_BASE_URL=https://api.paxity.io/v1 -> overridden to transaction.paxity.io/api/v1 with warning, (b) https://api.paxity.com/v1 -> overridden with warning, (c) https://transaction.paxity.io/api/v1 -> kept unchanged, no warning, (d) unset -> defaults to transaction.paxity.io/api/v1. Diagnostic + config + validation errors + 18 regression tests all green. Production issue on shopenchine.com can only be resolved by user redeploying — the guard now ensures the next redeploy self-corrects even if the prod env var still points to a stale host.
rca of the issue: Production (shopenchine.com) was still configured with PAXITY_BASE_URL=https://api.paxity.io/v1 (legacy host that returns 401 for all requests). Live working host is https://transaction.paxity.io/api/v1. Self-heal guard added at module import time in paxity_router.py detects the two legacy substrings ('api.paxity.com', 'api.paxity.io') and forces the working live base URL, logging a warning. This guarantees production self-corrects on next redeploy without requiring the user to change env vars in the production env store.
